title: Add release bundle digest manifest
summary: Alpha release bundles currently bind evidence and validation notes, but they do not record stable file digests for bundle contents. Add a deterministic manifest so operators can verify bundle files have not drifted before signatures or public transparency are implemented.
expectedFailureModes: A release bundle file changes after review without any local integrity signal.
The manifest records nondeterministic metadata that changes on every validation run.
Docs imply signed or public transparency guarantees when the implementation only provides local digest binding.
nextAction: Generate manifest.json with SHA-256 digests for evidence.json and validation.md, validate the manifest in the bundle gate, document the contract, and add regression coverage for tampered bundle files.
